question:
Which of the following pair of "player – sports" is correct?

I. Anshu Malik – Boxing

II. Eldhose Paul – Triple Jump
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eldhose Paul's** remarkable rise in the world of athletics is indeed a testament to his perseverance and hard work.
 
• He won India's first gold medal in the men's triple jump event at the Commonwealth Games in Birmingham on **August 8, 2022.**
 
• This victory not only brought him recognition within India but also garnered attention on the international stage.
 
• Before his Commonwealth Games triumph,** Eldhose Paul** made history by becoming the first Indian triple jumper to qualify for the final at the World Athletics Championships in Oregon.
 
• This achievement showcased his talent and potential to compete at the highest level of the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Anshu Malik **Winning a silver medal at the **World Wrestling Championships** is a remarkable feat, especially considering she became **the first Indian woman to reach the final in the history of the event.**
 
• **Anshu's accomplishment** surpassed the achievements of renowned wrestlers like Geeta Phogat and Vinesh Phogat, which speaks volumes about her talent and dedication.
 
• **Anshu's success **extends beyond the World Championships.
 
• She has also secured a silver medal at the Commonwealth Games, another prestigious international sporting event.
 
• Additionally, she has earned the title of Asian champion in her weight category, further solidifying her position as a top-class wrestler.
 
• Moreover, by the **age of 21**,** Anshu** has already participated in the Olympics, which is the pinnacle of athletic competition.
 
• Such early exposure to the world stage bodes well for her future career, as she gains invaluable experience and continues to hone her skills.
